rules.name: provider-neutral STT contract
rules.requirement: Whisper MUST consume fa3.stt-media-request.v1 and produce fa3.stt-media-result.v1 without changing canonical STT semantics.

rules.name: official model allowlist only
rules.requirement: Only registry-allowlisted official Whisper model names may be loaded.

rules.name: arbitrary checkpoint path forbidden
rules.requirement: Arbitrary local .pt checkpoint paths MUST NOT be accepted by the production provider surface.

rules.name: model artifact hash verification
rules.requirement: Model bytes MUST match the canonical SHA256 before execution; post-download bytes MUST be reverified.

rules.name: runtime version pin
rules.requirement: The installed openai-whisper runtime version MUST match the canonical pinned version.

rules.name: network fetch explicit
rules.requirement: Network model fetch MUST be disabled by default and requires explicit per-run opt-in.

rules.name: explicit device selection
rules.requirement: Upstream implicit CUDA auto-selection MUST NOT be used; device is explicit FA3 execution input.

rules.name: HRB lease required for CUDA
rules.requirement: CUDA execution MUST require a valid AcceleratorExecutionLease@1 from the Host Resource Broker.

rules.name: GPU UUID revalidation
rules.requirement: The CUDA ordinal MUST resolve to the same GPU UUID carried by the active HRB lease.

rules.name: HRB memory budget projection
rules.requirement: The HRB memory_max_bytes budget MUST be projected into the PyTorch allocator guard before model inference.

rules.name: prepared audio hash binding
rules.requirement: The request audio_hash MUST equal the actual prepared-audio SHA256 before transcription.

rules.name: canonical STT audio shape
rules.requirement: Production media STT input MUST be 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV as emitted by FA3-BLACKHOLE-KDENLIVE-001.

rules.name: timing validation
rules.requirement: Provider-native segment timings MUST be finite, nonnegative, increasing and non-overlapping before result promotion.

rules.name: word timing preservation
rules.requirement: When word timestamps are requested, word timing evidence MUST be preserved in the typed result.

rules.name: translation separation
rules.requirement: Whisper upstream translate mode MUST NOT be exposed through this STT provider; translation remains a distinct FA3 typed artifact/stage.

rules.name: typed shell-free integration
rules.requirement: Blackhole MUST invoke the provider through explicit request/result artifacts with shell=False semantics.

rules.name: no Conda/Miniforge runtime
rules.requirement: The provider implementation MUST use a normal per-provider Python venv and MUST NOT require Conda/Miniforge.

rules.name: execution lineage evidence
rules.requirement: Every PASS result MUST identify provider/runtime/model/artifact hash/device/HRB lease and transcription timing evidence.
